extraction_notes: This is the shared BAT54W THRU BAT54SW datasheet covering BAT54W (single, marking KL5), BAT54AW (KL6), BAT54CW (KL7) and BAT54SW (KL8). BAT54SW is the series-connected dual Schottky pair variant in SOT-323 per the p. 1 Function Diagram; the dual-series identity is preserved. All electrical characteristics and curves are specified per single diode junction, not across the series pair; the series path through both diodes drops two junction voltages.
Table/scalar limits were extracted first from the p. 1 Maximum Ratings and p. 2 Electrical Characteristics tables; SI units used throughout (A, V, F, s).

Curves were digitized from the embedded PDF vector paths (PyMuPDF get_drawings bezier sampling), not raster pixel reading. Axis anchors from grid lines and tick labels: Fig. 1 x = 0-800 mV linear (px 71.44-259.89), y = 0.1-200 mA log (decade approx 50.6 px); Fig. 2 x = 0-30 V linear (px 351.33-539.46), y = 0.01-100 uA log (decade approx 41.8 px); Fig. 3 x = 0-20 V linear, y = 0-20 pF linear. Curves interpolated at round abscissa values.

Digitized curves are self-consistent with the limit table: Fig. 1 25 degC gives VF approx 0.246 V at 1 mA (max 0.32 V), 0.326 V at 10 mA (max 0.40 V), 0.474 V at 100 mA (max 1.0 V); Fig. 2 25 degC gives IR approx 0.44 uA at 25 V (max 2.0 uA); Fig. 3 gives CT approx 9.6 pF at VR = 1 V (max 10 pF).

The Fig. 1 vector paths span 0.0995 mA to 199.1 mA; the top points (0.578 V and 0.566 V at 199 mA) use the true path extremes just below the 200 mA chart top. Fig. 2 paths start at approx 0.9-0.95 V, so no 0 V point is recorded.

Absolute maximum ratings on p. 1 (VRRM = 30 V, VRMS = 21 V, VDC = 30 V, IF(AV) = 200 mA, IFSM = 600 mA at 8.3 ms half-sine, PD = 200 mW, Tj = 125 degC, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 500 degC/W) are operating-region evidence only and were not fitted.
Fig. 4 is a power derating curve, not a diode IV characteristic, and was not digitized.
The supplied PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.
Public datasheet only; no vendor SPICE models were consulted.
omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no measured breakdown row (no V(BR) at a specified IR); only 30 V maximum-rating reverse voltages are given, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current remain null.
